description: Tool calling schemas, structured outputs with Zod/Pydantic, streaming chat loops, defensive prompting, and ready-to-test LLM endpoints.
ai_rules: When building tool-calling agents, strictly define parameters with JSON Schemas or Zod objects and provide clear descriptions for each parameter.
Always validate LLM output schema defensively and implement automatic retry or error recovery when the model generates invalid JSON.
Keep system prompts concise, deterministic, and modular; separate instructions from untrusted user data.
